facts.statement: Episode date 2026-10-05 09:00 Europe/London. Alder Court Offices has one warm meeting room; the rest of the site is operational. Site receptionist Lee reports “everything is down, urgent”. Lee may arrange access but has no spending authority.

Maintenance agreement AC-1 covers planned maintenance only. No reactive rates, response target or repair authority are supplied. Customer procurement contact Pat owns spending decisions; Service Manager owns internal review.

A separate report from the same site identifies water escaping near electrical plant. Competent engineer Sam is available; Daniel Mercer authorises immediate protective isolation and damage prevention only, with review at 11:00.
